notes.title: Special Announcement: Runner-up 'Studio Game Of The Year' Award
notes.content:
Guys!!! guess what?

Happy to announce that 'Switch - Or Die Trying' has 

Won runner-up 'Studio Game Of The Year' at NGDC 2017.

Yabadabadooo!!!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27758100/e5b3a1d88bff60bd9f03456e9b7b5e4a709273bd.jpg
[spoiler]sorry for being vain and posting my own picture[/spoiler]

NOW is a good time to BUY 'Switch - Or Die Trying'
http://store.steampowered.com/app/506090/Switch__Or_Die_Trying/
[spoiler] stop reading spoilers and buy the game already! [/spoiler]
[spoiler]okay, bare minimum, add us to your wishlist[/spoiler]
[spoiler]fine, at the very least, give the free demo try[/spoiler]
[spoiler]but ya, if you buy the game it would mean a lot, and really help us[/spoiler]
[spoiler]don't forget to spread the word by sharing this with your friends and family[/spoiler]
[spoiler]okay, now its getting out of hand, bye[/spoiler]
[spoiler]persistence pays, here's a steam key for one lucky user I44ZQ-XYKG9-4BXLW [/spoiler]
[spoiler]bye :-*[/spoiler]

Thank you for the love and support.
Love, SwitchDevs.

notes.title: Free Demo
notes.content:
Hello, 

You can now try the Free Demo of 'Switch - Or Die Trying'.

Please share this with your friends.

If you enjoyed the Demo 
Please! consider purchasing the Full Version
Every Paid Purchase Counts.
And do leave a Review.

This Demo was made during Greenlight and has a few caveats:
-Contains limited levels (full game has 75 levels, demo only 12)
-Does not full reflect the final polish
-May contain bugs that have been addressed in the full version of the game

As a throwback, here's a few youtubers reviewing the Demo:
https://youtu.be/KIGjOCb49C8
special info*- the game was originally titled 'Switch' (as seen in this demo). We had to expand the name in the final version to differentiate ourselves from the console. 
:)

Thank you.
